name: duopore-public-supplier-leadtime-dates
description: Estimate whether an order can arrive before your deadline using the delivery times you enter.

interface.longDescription: Estimate whether an order can arrive before your deadline using the delivery times you enter. Add the order date, production days, transit days, deadline and buffer. See estimated dispatch and arrival dates and the time left. It counts calendar days and does not check tracking, holidays or supplier promises. The dates are estimates, not a delivery guarantee.
defaultPrompt: Estimate this order's arrival date from production and transit days.
Will these supplied delivery times leave my chosen buffer?

positive.prompt: Use Supplier Leadtime Dates with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"orderDate":"2026-10-01","requiredBy":"2026-10-20","bufferDays":3,"quotes":[{"id":"Q1","productionDays":7,"transitDays":5},{"id":"Q2","productionDays":15,"transitDays":5}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts.
